market_outlook.short_term: ASX faces headwinds from oil-driven inflation, RBA rate hike fears, and property stress. Expect choppy, range-bound trading with sector rotation into gold and defensives. Wall Street strength provides partial support but domestic macro is deteriorating. 1–3 month bias: cautiously negative, ^AORD likely testing support.
market_outlook.long_term: Productivity decline and per capita recession risk cap structural upside. Housing correction (10% downside) will weigh on financials and REITs for 6–12 months. Gold and energy transition (solar > coal) offer thematic tailwinds. RBA policy path is the dominant variable. Medium-term bias: neutral-to-negative until inflation and housing stabilise.
